summary: Learn to assess data capability, clarify ownership and shape a practical governance roadmap. Explore the five-day course and enrol with TrainingCred.
lede: Data strategy and governance connect data priorities to business outcomes and establish ownership, decision rights and controls. For data stewards, business analysts and transformation leads, the course helps turn unclear ownership and competing priorities into a practical roadmap. You will assess governance capability, map decision rights and define quality measures for critical data, then shape phased actions and progress reporting for digital workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, maintain or rely on organizational data and need a practical governance structure to support digital transformation.
prerequisites: No prior data-governance role is required. Familiarity with organizational data workflows is helpful; coding or programming is not required.
